title: Localize RepeatQuestItem's 'end series' message
description: Replace the hardcoded template literal with a resource-backed lookup using the task title as a format arg.
acceptance_criteria: The hardcoded string template is replaced by stringResource(R.string.end_series_message, task.title)
start_anchor: message = "\"${task.title}\" and its entire recurring series will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone. To just skip today's occurrence instead, use the delete button on the active quest in Active Quests.",
